Why you have a lot issue  to complete ivx ia as senior developer?? FINAL MILESTONE — IVX IA 10/10 AUTONOMOUS SENIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPER

Do not produce another narrative.

Do not evaluate.
Do not explain.
Close every remaining technical gap with evidence.

The acceptance standard is equivalent to a senior engineer at a top software company.

1. REAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
Complete at least 10 real engineering tasks across different IVX modules.

Examples:
- Registration
- Owner authentication
- IVX IA Chat
- Autonomous worker
- Reels
- Members
- Investors
- Landing
- API
- Dashboard

Tasks must include real bug fixes, refactors, performance improvements, or production features—not demo or sentinel-label changes.

2. FULL AUTONOMY
For every task, complete without manual code changes:
Requirements → Analysis → Code → Tests → Commit → PR → Approval → Merge → Deploy → Production Verification → Evidence.

No manual recovery at COMMITTING, PR, MERGE, or DEPLOY stages.

3. SELF-TESTING
The autonomous system must execute its own:
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- End-to-end tests
- TypeScript
- Lint
- Security checks

Do not rely on external confirmation.

4. SELF-RECOVERY
If any step fails:
- Detect the failure.
- Identify the root cause.
- Repair it automatically.
- Retry only the failed step.
- Continue the workflow.

No human intervention.

5. IVX IA CHAT
The chat must:
- Understand complex engineering requests.
- Maintain long-term project context.
- Generate implementation plans.
- Execute approved work.
- Return live progress.
- Return commits, PRs, deployments, and production verification.

6. REAL FEATURE DELIVERY
Implement and deploy multiple production features that users can verify inside the IVX application.

7. ENTERPRISE QUALITY
Achieve:
- Zero TypeScript errors.
- Zero lint errors.
- Zero failing tests.
- Zero deployment mismatches.
- Zero worker crashes.
- Zero false success reports.
- Zero manual recovery.
- Zero placeholder code.

8. SECURITY
Verify:
- Owner authorization.
- Audit logs.
- Protected deployment.
- Branch protection.
- Secrets never exposed.
- Role-based permissions.

9. PROOF
For every completed task provide:
- Root cause.
- Files changed.
- Tests executed.
- Commit SHA.
- PR number.
- Deployment ID.
- Production SHA.
- Production verification.
- Before/after behavior.

10. FINAL ACCEPTANCE

IVX IA can only be rated 10/10 if it repeatedly demonstrates all of the following:

✓ Solves real engineering problems.
✓ Writes production-quality code.
✓ Tests its own work.
✓ Deploys successfully.
✓ Verifies production automatically.
✓ Recovers from failures automatically.
✓ Completes end-to-end work without human intervention.
✓ Produces reproducible evidence for every task.
✓ Maintains the IVX platform over time with consistent reliability.

Do not return another progress report until every remaining gap is either resolved with evidence or explicitly identified with its root cause and corrective action.
